1.

Our Father! We from the heart thank Thee For all Thy grace, For Him, who on earth has accomplished Thy counsel of salvation. Thanks, that Thine only Son, Thy beloved, Thou didst freely give to be our Saviour.

2.

Thanks, Lord Jesus, that Thou didst come down here And didst good, And all the weak, sorrowful Thou didst help In body and soul; The poor world, however, in its sin gave Thee Only a crown of thorns, a cross, a grave.

3.

But God hath exalted Thee, and we see Thee now With glory crowned, Our Captain of salvation, after suffering By God rewarded. Now many sons in righteousness By the Father are brought forth unto glory.

4.

So teach us, dear Lord, to know Thee, Where Thou now art, Thou Sun of life, God’s Son, the Firstborn, Beloved of the Father! Thou, who in the light hast brought forth eternal life, To Thee be dominion, majesty, and power!
